subject: general
question: In which of the following countries was the Men’s T-20 ICC World Cup-2021 staged?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Oman - UAE'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Men's T-20 ICC World Cup-2021 was staged in **Oman, UAE.**
 
• It was the **7th** T20 Men's World Cup Tournament.
 
• Matches were played **from 17 October 2021 to 14 November 2021** in the United Arab Emirates(UAE).
 
• After defeating England by five wickets in the semi-finals,** New Zealand** became the first team to reach the final.
 
• New Zealand have never before qualified to a T20 World Cup final. 
 
• **Australia**, which defeated Pakistan by five wickets in the second semifinal, joined them in the championship match.
 
• **Australia won **the first T20 World Cup after defeating New Zealand by eight wickets in the championship match.
 
• David Warner was voted** Player of the Tournament**, and Mitchell Marsh was chosen **Player of the Match.**
